from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, date

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/41297/1_41297_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/41297_0_7d804b05/1_41297_output.xlsx"

def date_key(v):
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return (v.year, v.month, v.day)
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return (v.year, v.month, v.day)
    return v

wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Build lookup from the daily data table (Column B area): dates in L, values in M.
daily_values = {}
for row in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
    d = ws.cell(row=row, column=12).value  # L
    val = ws.cell(row=row, column=13).value # M
    if d is not None and val is not None and not isinstance(d, str):
        daily_values[date_key(d)] = val

# Fill only the required answer cells F4:F18, matching dates from E4:E18.
for row in range(4, 19):
    target_date = ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value  # E
    ws.cell(row=row, column=6).value = daily_values.get(date_key(target_date), "#N/A")
